answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The comet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vertex. The zephyr of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
